questions.prompt: The king's daughter was betrayed by the treachery of the enemy.
questions.answer: Fīlia rēgis fraude hostium prōdita est.

questions.prompt: The poet gave gifts to the girls with a gentle voice.
questions.answer: Poēta puellīs dōna mītī vōce dedit.

questions.prompt: The swan flew over the still waters of the lake.
questions.answer: Cycnus super placidās aquās lacūs volāvit.

questions.prompt: Ignorant of his fate, the soldier hunted in the woods.
questions.answer: Fātī ignōrāns mīles in silvīs vēnābātur.

questions.prompt: The consul killed the traitor with a sword in the forum.
questions.answer: Cōnsul prōditōrem gladiō in forō necāvit.

questions.prompt: A mother's love conquers the fears of her children.
questions.answer: Amor mātris timōrēs līberōrum vincit.

questions.prompt: In Rome the citizens feared the anger of the gods.
questions.answer: Rōmae cīvēs īram deōrum timēbant.

questions.prompt: The wicked man deceived the crowd with false hope.
questions.answer: Improbus vir turbam falsā spē dēcēpit.

questions.prompt: The oracle foretold great dangers to the leaders of the Greeks.
questions.answer: Ōrāculum ducibus Graecōrum magna perīcula praedīxit.

questions.prompt: The farmer's fields were destroyed by a sudden storm.
questions.answer: Agrī agricolae subitā tempestāte dēlētī sunt.

questions.prompt: We heard the words of the wise old man with great joy.
questions.answer: Verba sapientis senis magnō gaudiō audīvimus.

questions.prompt: O citizens, defend the walls of the city with courage!
questions.answer: Ō cīvēs, moenia urbis virtūte dēfendite!

questions.prompt: The general led the army across the wide river.
questions.answer: Dux exercitum trāns lātum flūmen dūxit.

questions.prompt: The girl's beauty pleased the eyes of all the guests.
questions.answer: Fōrma puellae oculīs omnium hospitum placuit.

questions.prompt: Hidden in a cave, the fox lay in wait for the birds.
questions.answer: In latebrā occulta vulpēs avibus īnsidiābātur.

questions.prompt: The sailors sought safety from the fury of the sea.
questions.answer: Nautae salūtem ā furōre maris petīvērunt.

questions.prompt: The philosopher's books were dear to the young men.
questions.answer: Librī philosophī iuvenibus cārī erant.

questions.prompt: At Athens the orator moved the minds of the people with words.
questions.answer: Athēnīs ōrātor animōs populī verbīs mōvit.

questions.prompt: The gentle queen freed the captives from their chains.
questions.answer: Mītis rēgīna captīvōs vinculīs līberāvit.

questions.prompt: The enemy's ships were burned by fire in the harbor.
questions.answer: Nāvēs hostium ignī in portū incēnsae sunt.

questions.prompt: The teacher taught the boys the songs of the poets.
questions.answer: Magister puerōs carmina poētārum docuit.

questions.prompt: For the sake of glory, the young man endured many wounds.
questions.answer: Glōriae causā iuvenis multa vulnera tulit.
